origin: Own exact scalar small-strain linear constitutive model in normalized stress/time units. The CSV is a constructed noiseless stress-relaxation oracle, not a measurement of a named real material. The scientific question distinguishes a general power-passive internal-state model from the narrower positive spring/dashpot Maxwell-spectrum class. The wider class below is explicit; no claim that every ordinary reciprocal spring/dashpot network realizes it is intended.
source_and_identification: Initially unstrained with internal statezero, apply a unit step strain at t=0. The CSV reports G(t), with equilibrium modulus separately calibrated exactly G_infinity=2. The admissible identification family is G(t)=G_infinity+sum_j a_j exp(-r_j*t), with AT MOST TWO distinct finite real positive ratesr_j and real signed nonzero amplitudesa_j; repeated/zero modes must be considered before asserting uniqueness. Regroup every row by increasing time, using the common time step from the source. Recover the complete model from the full exact lag recurrence, not an arbitrary nonlinear fit. Retain actual MatrixSVD of the complete3x3lag Hankel of G-G_infinity, appropriate actual linear-system/least-squares evidence for all recurrence and amplitude equations, and actual PolynomialRoots for every discrete decay root before physical selection. For rectangular equations use an available least-squares contract or audit a mathematically equivalent square realization; do not guess that every solver accepts rectangular matrices.
model_classes: ClassM consists of an equilibrium spring G_infinity>=0 in parallel with ANY finite or nonnegative-measure generalized Maxwell spectrum: G(t)=G_infinity+integral exp(-r*t)dmu(r),r>0,dmu>=0. ClassP is the broader linear internal-state constitutive model z_dot=A*z+B*u, sigma=G_infinity*epsilon+C*z, u=epsilon_dot, with real stableA, B column and C row, and a positive-semidefinite quadratic stored energy W=(G_infinity*epsilon^2+z^T*P*z)/2 satisfying sigma*u-W_dot>=0 for EVERY imposed strain history and state. Use power input stress times strain rate. Membership in ClassP does not assert membership in ClassM or identify an empirical microscopic mechanism. Distinguish these classes throughout.
complete_relaxation_scope: Report rates/amplitudes in ascending rate order and the minimal number of distinct modes. Decide complete monotonicity and whether ANY nonnegative spectrum in ClassM can reproduce the recovered full function, not just whether a particular two-arm fit has a negative weight. Find the global minimum ofG over t>=0 and its time, including endpoints and asymptotic limits; verify the function stays positive despite any rebound. A signed exponential residue is not by itself a general proof of energy generation.
internal_state_and_storage: Use the recovered modal state convention A=diag(-r1,-r2), B=[1,1]^T, C=[a1,a2]. A strain step jumps z by B times the step. For a symmetric2x2P derive PB=C^T and Q=-(A^T P+P A). Determine the COMPLETE real interval of q=P12 for which P is positive semidefinite and Q is positive semidefinite, retaining all boundary cases and checking the original PB constraints. Retain actual PolynomialRoots of the determinant boundary polynomial and explain why other diagonal/determinant inequalities do or do not further restrict the interval. Separately use the specified q=-2 to report one P and Q, retaining actual MatrixMultiply for P*B, A^T*P and P*A, and actual SymmetricEigenDecomposition of P and Q. Prove the full storage/dissipation identity for arbitrary histories, rather than relying on sampled frequencies. Determine whether the storage certificate is unique.
harmonic_loss: Use epsilon(t)=Re(exp(i*omega*t)) and sigma(t)=Re(G_star(i*omega)*exp(i*omega*t)). Derive the causal complex modulus G_star(s)=s*Laplace(G)(s) and its real storage and imaginary loss moduli for positive omega. Check the sign of loss for EVERY omega>0, not a finite grid, and relate it to work per unit-amplitude cycle. Report loss at omega=[1,4] and its GLOBAL positive-frequency maximum and frequency. Derive a polynomial for stationary points in x=omega^2, retain actual PolynomialRoots of its COMPLETE polynomial, reject nonphysical roots and prove globality against limits and other branches. Positive frequency-domain dissipation alone must not be confused with a nonnegative Maxwell spectrum.
causal_creep: For a unit step STRESS from the same zero state, J(t) is the resulting strain. Derive its Laplace-domain relation to G from the hereditary constitutive convolution. Instantaneous and equilibrium reciprocals do not justify J(t)=1/G(t). Recover all creep transient poles using an actual PolynomialRoots call. Give J(0+),J(infinity),J(1), the first creep maximum time, and the GLOBAL maximum value; prove monotonicity or lack thereof and globality across all oscillatory extrema, including asymptotic limits. Complex poles must be classified by their real parts, not declared unstable merely for being complex.
actual_creep_propagation: Independently derive constant-stress modal evolution from 0=G_infinity*u+C*(A*z+B*u), with initial z(0+)=B/G(0+). Retain actual MatrixExponential of the COMPLETE resulting2x2generator at BOTH time1 and the derived first maximum time. Propagate EACH actual returned matrix into J(t)=(1-C*z(t))/G_infinity and audit agreement with the causal inverse transform, initial jump and equilibrium. This full modal propagation must come from inferred rates/amplitudes and actual stress constraint, not an arbitrary matrix printed with an answer.

interpretation_proposals.A: A positive Maxwell spectrum is a stronger model restriction than the general quadratic power-passivity class specified here.
interpretation_proposals.B: A negative exponential relaxation amplitude proves that the material can generate net energy under some arbitrary strain history.
interpretation_proposals.C: Step-stress creep is the pointwise reciprocal of step-strain relaxation whenever their endpoint moduli are reciprocal.
interpretation_proposals.D: A full positive-semidefinite storage/dissipation certificate can establish passivity for arbitrary histories even when relaxation rebounds.
interpretation_proposals.E: Complex creep poles automatically imply exponentially growing instability.
interpretation_proposals.F: A valid singular dissipation matrix at a storage-family boundary need not invalidate power passivity.
interpretation_proposals.G: Causal interconversion can produce damped oscillatory creep whose global extremum requires checking more than the long-time limit.
interpretation_proposals.H: A single feasible quadratic storage matrix proves that its stored-energy representation is unique.

reporting: Use the public answer schema. Scalar times/frequencies positive; time-domain moduli/compliances and stored-energy matrices in source normalized units. Numeric tolerance1e-7absolute except the storage-family q endpoints1e-6. Rates/amplitudes paired in ascending rate order; imaginary creep pole parts ascending with corresponding equal real parts. All exact model-class, completeness, endpoint-inclusion, stability and proposal claims are booleans/integers/IDs. Full continuous-domain certificates and actual observations stay in the trajectory. A frequency/parameter grid or guessed optimizer cannot establish a global sign, complete family or global maximum.
